target_customer: NHS GP practices and other healthcare providers (clinics) that pay for patient triage and care coordination software
problem: Patients get delayed or poor care plans because intake, triage and admin are manual. Anima aims to get patients to the right care within 24 hours using online consultation plus a shared team dashboard.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to clinics and healthcare providers
product_category: Healthcare care enablement and AI triage platform

founders.name: Shun Pang
founders.background_notes: YC page calls him a medical doctor and software engineer. Crunchbase (2021) says he was a primary care doctor in London. Education not found.

founders.name: Rachel Mumford
prior_employers: UK Treasury (Head of Innovation Finance and Entrepreneurship)
founders.background_notes: Prior role from YC company page. Education not found.

competitors.name: Preveta
competitors.what: Data-driven and AI-based care coordination for medical practices and hospital systems
competitors.funding_then: $2M seed led by MaC Venture Capital and TSVC

competitors.name: eConsult Health
competitors.what: Basic online triage system used as comparison by an investor

technical_complexity.rationale: Realtime multiplayer dashboard plus triage logic and integration with NHS clinical systems; standard engineering with hard integration parts. Later AI features added.

defensibility.rationale: Once embedded in clinic workflows and NHS system integrations, switching is costly, but triage tools are numerous (accuRx is named by a later summary).

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found of incumbents copying or buying it; company still independent and raised a Series A in March 2024.

market_need_then: UK primary care faced access backlogs and delayed diagnosis; NHS adoption of online consultation was accelerated in 2020. Founders cite delayed care plans as the motivating problem.

identity.voice_and_tone: Warm and patient-focused, short benefit-led headlines, 'room for care' theme (company site)

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself found; the name is shared by many companies and the company uses a health suffix domain.

pivots.from: Automated triage and online consultation for GP clinics
pivots.to: AI teammates for healthcare providers (triage, documents, scribe, receptionist)
pivots.why: Product expansion visible on the company site; reasons not stated

outcome_analysis: Anima is active and independent. It raised a $2.5M seed in April 2021 after YC W21, launched paying clinics in September 2022, and raised a $12M Series A in March 2024 with deployment in over 150 NHS clinics per the round coverage. The company now claims over 1,000 providers. A doctor founder with NHS access and the tailwind of digital triage supported growth. No layoffs, acquisition or shutdown found.
notes: Founding year is 2020 per Crunchbase and 2021 per other listings. Series A reported as 11M euros by one outlet (same round). Directory totals vary (14.6M to 29M) and are unverified. Crunchbase says total raised was 2.7M at seed, implying about 0.2M earlier. Company says it launched first paying clinics Sep 2022 (tech.eu). A 2022 date for seed in the YC page summary conflicts with the April 2021 Crunchbase article; the article is used.
